name: Systemic Mastocytosis with Associated Clonal Hematological non-Mast-Cell Lineage Disease
description: Systemic mastocytosis with an associated clonal hematological non-mast cell lineage disease is a form of systemic mastocytosis (SM) associated with malignancy (other than mast cell leukemia).
